$description: Qdrant colors. The `color` group is the primitives, copied exactly from the Figma file Qdrant Design System Primitives (UUpGTk4Ifmpr0FwNr6pXVg), exported 2026-11-12; `neutral-975` was added here first and then to the Figma file, on 2026-11-16, and so was a 975 for every other color on 2026-11-19. The other groups are this repo's brand layer: semantic tokens, so they stay out of the Figma file, which holds primitives only. They are the brand color names, roles for creatives and web, gradients and the mascot glow, all aliases of the primitives. Source of truth: this file. colors.css is generated from it by primitives/build.mjs.

color.$description: Color primitives. Raw values only: no meaning. Use semantic tokens in components.

975.$description: The design system's dark page (design lead, 2026-11-16): halfway from 950 to black in sRGB, rounded so it keeps 950's hue (H 216°, S 56%, B 3.5%). Added in this repo first, then to the Figma file the same day.

neutral.$description: Deep Space 216 neutral (HCT hue 255, saturation-balanced). 0 = white, 1000 = black. 850 and 925 support the background roles, and 975 is the design system's dark page.

975.$description: The deepest tint (design lead, 2026-11-19): halfway from amaranth-950 to black, keeping its hue, like neutral-975. Step 1 of the adaptive scale in dark. Added in this repo first, then to the Figma file.

brand.$description: Named brand colors for people (marketing, guidelines). Aliases of the primitives.

indigo.$description: Indigo, Qdrant's action and accent color.

asset.$description: Colors that belong to one brand asset, not to the palette.

mascotGlow.$description: Qbot's glow only (brand-assets/mascot). Same value as Design Lab.

brand.$description: Amaranth to indigo, 135deg. Hero moments only, never on text.

headshot.$description: Indigo, 204deg, both stops at 70%. Only behind headshot cutouts (headshot-card, headshot-circle). From Figma Brand-Collateral, node 2183:29300.

semantic.$description: Roles, dark theme (the default), the same groups and values as the Color collection in the Figma file Qdrant Brand Design (2u6KfDsYjibQuf9ji6lFBR) since 2026-11-21: text, primary, secondary, status (one group per state), background, border, dataviz and static. Use these in creatives and web, never a primitive step, unless a README says so. A few roles stay in this repo only, for creatives: background.light and light-surface, text.on-light and body-on-light, border.on-dark and on-light. primary.primary and secondary.secondary are --qd-color-primary and --qd-color-secondary.

raised.$description: Cards and boxes one level up

overlay.$description: Overlays, and a card inside a card

light.$description: A light piece on a dark creative

secondary.$description: Body and supporting text on dark. 500 or lighter keeps AA (Figma contrast rules)

on-light.$description: Text on the light card and on light pieces, in creatives, whatever the theme

body-on-light.$description: Body text in documents and on the light card

on-accent.$description: Text on primary and secondary, like a button label

primary.$description: Buttons and the one strong mark: --qd-color-primary. amaranth-600 in both themes

hover.$description: The primary button on hover. amaranth-700 in both themes, so hover always darkens (design lead, 2026-11-21)

secondary.$description: Secondary marks, and the accent in product UI: --qd-color-secondary. indigo-600 in both themes

text.$description: Text and icons on its soft fill

default.$description: Lines that need to show: chart gridlines, tables

strong.$description: Fields and outline buttons, at 3:1. neutral-500 in both themes

on-dark.$description: Decorative borders on dark pieces in creatives, whatever the theme

on-light.$description: Borders on the light card and on light pieces in creatives, whatever the theme

text.$description: Text and icons in badges and alerts

white.$description: White that never changes with the theme: text and logos on photos, art on patterns

black.$description: Black that never changes with the theme: scrims on images

light.$description: Light theme overrides, used with [data-theme="light"]. Roles not listed here are the same in both themes: primary.primary and hover, secondary.secondary, border.strong, dataviz, static, and the creative-only roles.

secondary.$description: 600 or darker keeps AA on light (Figma contrast rules)

text.$description: indigo-700 since 2026-11-24 (design lead), one step lighter than indigo-800: 8.1:1 on white
